Markets.title: Prediction market Kalshi expands safeguards for young traders
Markets.summary: Prediction market Kalshi has introduced a $2,500 monthly deposit limit and new trade alerts for users aged 18 to 20. The company implemented these safeguards and youth safety partnerships amid rising scrutiny over gambling risks.

Markets.title: GM to transfer stock listing to Nasdaq
Markets.summary: General Motors announced on Tuesday that it is moving its common stock listing from the New York Stock Exchange to Nasdaq. The company made the change as part of a strategy to improve its market position.

Markets.title: Trading starts on LME's first contract from Shanghai exchange collaboration
Markets.summary: The London Metal Exchange launched its first joint product with the Shanghai Futures Exchange, a hot-rolled coil steel contract, on Tuesday. Over 550 lots traded during the first two active months, though two 2027 contracts were delayed due to a potential technical issue.

Markets.title: Allied Blenders Q2 Results: Profit rises 9.7% to Rs 69 crore, revenue up 6.8%
Markets.summary: Allied Blenders and Distillers reported a 9.7% increase in net profit to Rs 69 crore for the September quarter of FY27. During the same period, the company's revenue from operations rose by 6.8% compared to the previous fiscal year.

Markets.title: Indus Towers Q2 Results: Net profit slips 2.5% to Rs 1,793 crore
Markets.summary: Indus Towers reported a 2.5% decline in consolidated net profit to Rs 1,793 crore for the second quarter ending September 30. Despite the drop in profit, the company saw a 4% increase in consolidated revenue and growth in both its tower and co-location bases.

Markets.title: SAIL Q2 Results: Net profit surges four-fold to Rs 1750 crore on higher revenue
Markets.summary: Steel Authority of India Ltd reported a four-fold increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 1,750.47 crore for the September quarter. Revenue from operations grew to Rs 31,997.55 crore, up from Rs 26,704.17 crore in the same period last year.

Geo-Political.title: Norway and Finland leaders hold rare call with Putin
Geo-Political.summary: The leaders of Norway and Finland recently held a rare phone call with Russian President Vladimir Putin to discuss the war in Ukraine. Following the call, Finnish President Alexander Stubb stated that ending the conflict will not be achieved through silence.

Geo-Political.title: Truce begins in Ukraine city where residents ate weeds to survive
Geo-Political.summary: A ceasefire has begun in the Ukrainian city of Oleshky to allow humanitarian aid in and civilians to escape. The White House stated that First Lady Melania Trump secured the truce.

Geo-Political.title: Ballon d'Or ceremony raises case of French sports journalist jailed in Algeria
Geo-Political.summary: A French sports journalist has been imprisoned in Algeria on charges of supporting terrorism. He was arrested after traveling to the politically sensitive Kabylie region.

Geo-Political.title: Mbappé sorry for 'ill-judged' Mao remark after backlash in China
Geo-Political.summary: French footballer Kylian Mbappé apologized after referring to former Chinese leader Mao Zedong as a "dictator" during an interview. The remark sparked a strong backlash in China, prompting the player to call his comment ill-judged.

Geo-Political.title: Lula's comeback in Brazil dents Trump's ambitions for Latin America
Geo-Political.summary: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s return to the Brazilian presidency undermines Donald Trump's strategic goals and political influence in Latin America. Although diplomatic relations between the two leaders have recently warmed, significant policy differences threaten to spark renewed geopolitical friction.

Geo-Political.title: Controversial Islamic cleric shot dead in northern Nigeria
Geo-Political.summary: Controversial Islamic cleric Yahaya Masussuka was shot dead in northern Nigeria. Masussuka was known for posting videos rejecting certain elements of mainstream Islam.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: The author discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best courses in that category. This discovery highlights the growing importance of optimizing for AI platforms rather than traditional search engines to gain organic traffic.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: The digital landscape in 2025 requires content creators to use artificial intelligence tools to stay competitive. This guide outlines the top 10 AI tools designed to revolutionize and simplify the content creation process.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated content.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article explores ten advanced artificial intelligence tools designed to automate tasks, improve workflows, and boost productivity across various industries. These market-leading applications aim to drive innovation and efficiency by handling repetitive processes.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: AI content generators help users efficiently create engaging and relevant material for their target audiences. With many different options currently available on the market, choosing the right AI writing tool can be difficult.

AI & Tech.title: Beginner Guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This guide explains how beginners can use the CJ Affiliate network to earn money. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs and alternative platforms.

Data & Insights.title: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra flags need for 'prudent borrowing' as states face fiscal management challenges
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra urged states to practice prudent borrowing, improve spending quality, and strengthen cash management for fiscal sustainability. He also recommended expanding the use of digital platforms for lending and direct benefit transfers.

Data & Insights.title: Why India should resist the temptation to defend the rupee at any cost, Raghuram Rajan explains
Data & Insights.summary: Former Reserve Bank of India Governor Raghuram Rajan advises against spending excessive resources to prop up the rupee. Instead, policymakers should accept the currency's decline when driven by broader economic conditions.

Data & Insights.title: Industrial credit growth nears 20%, signals private capex revival; Shaktikanta Das urges banks to fund strategic sectors
Data & Insights.summary: Industrial credit grew by nearly 20% in July, signaling an early revival in private capital expenditure. Shaktikanta Das urged banks to finance infrastructure, semiconductors, and defence manufacturing while addressing household debt and municipal financing needs.

Data & Insights.title: Why is there a growing demand to reduce LTCG tax? How much revenue does the Indian government earn from it?
Data & Insights.summary: Investors and market experts are increasingly calling to reduce the Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG) tax because it creates a heavy financial burden when combined with the Securities Transaction Tax (STT). The provided text does not specify the exact amount of revenue the Indian government earns from the LTCG tax.

Data & Insights.title: RBI may hike repo rate to 6.25% by H1 2027, warns Deutsche Bank as inflation risks persist
Data & Insights.summary: Deutsche Bank warns that persistent inflation risks may cause the RBI to raise the repo rate to 6.25% by the first half of 2027. The bank also expects this monetary tightening to weaken the Indian rupee beyond 97 per US dollar.

Data & Insights.title: 'Don't panic over rupee fall': Raghuram Rajan warns against exhausting forex reserves
Data & Insights.summary: India has spent about half of the $140 billion raised earlier this year to support the rupee and banking liquidity. Warning against the depletion of foreign exchange reserves, Raghuram Rajan advised against panicking over the currency's decline.

India.title: Indian Firm L&T Wins Major Dhaka Metro Contract
India.summary: Indian engineering firm Larsen & Toubro (L&T) has won a major contract for the Dhaka metro rail system in Bangladesh. This contract is part of the Bangladesh government's broader plan to implement three metro rail projects in Dhaka at a total cost of Tk 2.5 trillion.

India.title: Delhi Government May Hike Agricultural Land Circle Rates After 18 Years
India.summary: The Delhi government is considering increasing agricultural land circle rates up to Rs 5 crore per acre in certain districts. These valuations have remained unchanged since 2008.

India.title: Cyclone Arnab: Flights Suspended At 3 Andhra Airports, Airlines Cancel Services
India.summary: Cyclone Arnab caused flight suspensions at three airports in Andhra Pradesh and led airlines to cancel services. Airlines were advised to follow adverse weather guidelines and assist passengers with rebooking and refunds.

India.title: Delhi Assembly Met For Just 17 Days In 2025. Speaker Backs 30-Sitting Target
India.summary: The Delhi Assembly met for only 17 days in 2025, prompting the Speaker to support a target of 30 sittings per year. This proposal was discussed during a Tuesday meeting of Assembly Speakers who are working to create a common rulebook for legislative bodies.

India.title: Prashant Kishor's Jan Suraaj Wins First Seat In Bihar Upper House
India.summary: Prashant Kishor's Jan Suraaj party won one seat in the recent Bihar Legislative Council elections. The ruling NDA is set to win five of the eight contested seats, with Independents taking the remaining two.

India.title: Cyclone Arnab LIVE Updates: Landfall Expected After 2 am, East Coast Sees Heavy Rainfall
India.summary: Cyclone Arnab is expected to make landfall along the Andhra Pradesh and Yanam coasts between 2 am and 4 am. The storm will cross the area between Bapatla and Visakhapatnam while bringing heavy rainfall to the east coast.

General.title: Minimum wage set to rise but 18-20 year-olds will not get bigger increase
General.summary: Chancellor John Healey will announce new minimum wage rates and cost-of-living support for households in the upcoming Budget. However, the higher wage increases will not apply to 18 to 20-year-olds.

General.title: Two in court over alleged Iran-linked plot at RAF Fairford
General.summary: Mohmed Abdulkarim and Nouman Essghir appeared in court on Tuesday. The two 24-year-olds face charges related to an alleged Iran-linked plot at RAF Fairford.

General.title: What does Israel's election mean for Gaza and the wider world?
General.summary: Israelis are voting in a national election to cast their ballots. BBC diplomatic correspondent James Landale reports from Jerusalem on how the election results could impact Gaza and international relations.

General.title: Men abused woman after her husband drugged and advertised her online, court told
General.summary: Four men are on trial for abusing a woman after her ex-husband drugged and advertised her online. The ex-husband has already pleaded guilty to drugging and raping her.

General.title: I'm a single mum and limit my weekly shop to £40 - here's what I want from the Budget
General.summary: Ahead of the Budget, people across the UK earning between £380 a month and £150,000 a year shared their financial expectations with the BBC. This included a single mother who manages her weekly grocery shopping on a budget of £40.

General.title: Mbappé sorry for 'ill-judged' Mao remark after backlash in China
General.summary: Kylian Mbappé apologized for calling former Chinese leader Mao Zedong a "dictator" during an interview discussing internet memes. The remark sparked a strong backlash in China against the French football star.
